tickets.title: Collect mortgage document packet
tickets.text: Collect the mortgage document packet for the Willowdoodle household's $417,000 fixed-rate mortgage on the $940,000 home at Teacup Comet Bank. This is needed to support the year-end planning review and any refinancing or principal payment decisions.
tickets.evidence: They agreed by November 15, 2023 to evaluate appreciated shares for Nadia’s planned $18,000 Moonbadger Literacy Foundation gift before holiday travel.

tickets.title: Coordinate charitable transfer
tickets.text: Coordinate a charitable transfer of $18,000 from Nadia Willowdoodle’s appreciated Copper Firefly Energy shares to the Moonbadger Literacy Foundation before holiday travel. Confirm the transfer method, tax considerations, and custodian requirements for the gift.

subTasks.title: Confirm gift intent and transfer method
subTasks.text: Document the charitable purpose, approximate gift amount or asset description, preferred timing, recipient organization details, and whether the transfer is intended as cash, appreciated securities, QCD, donor-advised fund contribution, or another method.

subTasks.title: Review tax and planning considerations
subTasks.text: Check whether the proposed transfer aligns with the financial plan, charitable deduction strategy, AGI limits, RMD status if applicable, cost basis considerations, and coordination needs with Nadia's CPA.

subTasks.title: Prepare transfer instructions and approvals
subTasks.text: Gather custodian forms, charity delivery instructions, account registration details, signature requirements, and any required compliance approvals before submitting the transfer request.

subTasks.title: Confirm completion and records
subTasks.text: Verify delivery with the custodian and recipient organization, save confirmations, note any acknowledgment letter needed, and update the planning record with final transfer details.

tickets.evidence: They agreed by November 15, 2023 to evaluate appreciated shares for Nadia’s planned $18,000 Moonbadger Literacy Foundation gift before holiday travel.

tickets.title: Obtain restricted stock vesting confirmation

tickets.title: Review cash reserve and bonus allocation
tickets.text: Review cash above the stated six-month reserve target and the expected December bonus for college savings, taxable investment, and mortgage principal comparisons.
